description: This file defines a notification service for handling user notifications, including request authorization, checking authorization status, and adding notification requests. It provides an abstraction over the UserNotifications framework with a protocol and a concrete implementation.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: An implementation of NotificationCentering that interacts with UNUserNotificationCenter to handle notification authorization and scheduling.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests user authorization for notifications with specified options.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a notification request to the notification center.
